notes: Shopify storefront (redirects to fenwick.co.uk canonical). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (general Allow: /). Site is a large multi-division UK department store (Fashion/Beauty/Home & Tech/Furniture/Foodhall/Kids/Gifts); this extraction covers only the Home & Tech division per assignment scope. IMPORTANT: none of these seasonal collections are currently linked from the main mega-menu (verified by parsing the full nav drawer HTML for every data-mod-title breadcrumb - zero Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine's home nodes present, likely because full Christmas nav goes live closer to the season). All rows below were discovered via sitemap_collections_*.xml (the site's own authoritative collection listing) cross-checked with the Shopify collections.json/products.json APIs, then verified live via rendered browser page (the 'N results' header). QTY METHOD: Shopify's own products_count field (collections.json) and full products.json enumeration were BOTH found to be substantially inflated versus what the storefront actually renders (e.g. 'Christmas' collection: products_count=211, products.json enumeration=160, but the live rendered page shows only '37 results'; 'Christmas Tree Lights': products_count=12 vs rendered '2 results'). Per qty-method priority, the rendered on-page 'N results' / 'Showing X of Y items' header was used as the authoritative qty for every row (tier 1, displayed total), not the Shopify API counts. EXCLUDED as marketing/theme/non-Home/zero-result, not extracted: Christmas Crackers (named collection exists, products_count=35, but live page renders 'No results found' - genuine 0 displayed products, dropped per zero-row policy, confirmed on reload); Christmas Golden Moments, Christmas Merry and Sweet, Christmas Into the Woods, Christmas House of Luxury (thin 0-1 product 'trend edit' style collections, not genuine product-type categories - theme vs category, rule 6); Halloween Hosting and Christmas Eve Boxes (cross-division curated 'hosting'/gift-box edits spanning Spirits/Chocolate/Cookware/Rugs/Wall Art/Books/Toys/Bedding - not a genuine single Home product-type PLP); Festive Hosting and Shop the Festive Edit (large cross-division marketing edits, majority Food & Drink or unclassified, not a coherent Home category); Festive Beauty (Beauty division, out of scope); Christmas at Fenwick, Sale Christmas, Christmas Giftsets, Christmas Food Gifts/Food Drink/Chocolate and Confectionery/Alcohol, Christmas Hampers, Sip Into Christmas, Christmas Gifts for Tech Lovers (food/drink/marketing, not Home decor product type); Advent Calendars/Beauty/Toys/Food Advent Calendars, Christmas Felt Story, Christmas Alphabet, The Adventurer Toys Shop (Toys/Kids, out of scope); Anna Nina Christmas, Jellycat Christmas(+tag), Diptyque Holiday Collection, Chanel Holiday (brand-listing pages, excluded per core rule); Holiday Shop / Mens/Womens/Kids Holiday Shop, Womens Holiday Dresses/Essentials, Seasonal Style (Men/Women/Kids), Seasonal Bags, New Season Womenswear/Menswear/Co-ords/Energy, Festival Ready(+Men), Back to School (UK 'Holiday'=vacation and general 'new season'/'seasonal' fashion, not festive-occasion Home decor - false-positive per rule); Easter, Easter Gifts, Easter Toys Edit, Easter Food and Drink Gifts (checked - Food/Drink and Kids-Toys divisions, not Home); Valentine's Day and Valentine's Gifts (0 products / Women's jewellery-accessories division; Valentine's Homeware is the genuine Home row, kept below); Mother's Day, Mother's Day Gifting, Father's Day, Father's Day Gifting (0 products or generic cross-division gifting pages, not a Home product-type category); Black Friday Top Picks (cross-division sale page). No Diwali/Eid/Holi/Navratri/Rakhi/Hanukkah/Thanksgiving/New Year Home categories exist anywhere in the collections sitemap (checked both sitemap_collections_1.xml and _2.xml for every festival keyword in the seasonal rules vocabulary) - absence confirmed by full sitemap enumeration, not by site search. OVERLAP: 'Christmas' (the general hub, 37 results) partially overlaps in product membership with several of the more specific rows below (e.g. some Christmas Tree Lights, Christmas Trees and Room Ornaments items also appear inside the general Christmas listing) but is not an identical duplicate of any single one (different counts/facets), so kept as its own row per the overlap rule. 'Christmas Trees' (7, tree-only) and 'Christmas Trees & Decor' (59, trees+decorations combined) are distinct sibling pages, not duplicates. Handle/title mismatch noted: URL /collections/christmas-novelty displays as 'Christmas Lighting' and /collections/christmas-novelty-1 displays as 'Christmas Novelty' (handles were evidently swapped/renamed at some point) - category names below follow the site's live displayed title, not the URL slug. 'Christmas Home Decor' has a '-1' URL suffix only because of a historic Shopify handle collision; no separate non-suffixed duplicate exists (verified /collections/christmas-home-decor returns 404).
